overview: The Council established a new Community Garden Commission and approved a $2.1 million loan order for sewer and drainage improvements in North Medford. The meeting also featured public testimony regarding business parking permit shortages and discussions on safety issues at Medford Housing Authority properties.

items.title: Commendations and Routine Ceremonial Items
items.summary: Presented commendations to the Medford High School Varsity Baseball team and approved various congratulatory resolutions and condolences.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Appointment and Security Discussion
items.summary: Confirmed Losa Julie Janvier as the tenant representative to the Medford Housing Authority and referred reports of assaults and drug activity at authority properties to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Ordinance Establishing Community Garden Commission
items.summary: Approved an ordinance establishing a Community Garden Commission and an associated revolving account with a $5,000 expenditure cap, following amendments to exempt Riverbend Park and modify board appointment powers.

items.title: Public Participation Regarding Business Parking Permits
items.summary: Referred a business owner's complaint regarding the city selling more business permits than available parking spaces to the Transportation Subcommittee and Parking Commission.

items.title: Loan Order for North Medford Sewer and Drainage Repairs
items.summary: Approved a $2,120,000 loan order for sewer system improvements, utilizing a 45% grant and a 0% interest loan from the MWRA.

items.title: Utility Petitions and Public Hearings
items.summary: Tabled a petition for a pole on Canal Street for a field meeting with neighbors, while approving conduit repairs on High Street and a pole installation on Prescott Street.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Claims
items.summary: Approved a $7,500 insurance settlement and the meeting records for June 30, 2015, while tabling the records for July 21, 2015.

items.title: Authorization for Municipal Preliminary Election
items.summary: Ordered the preliminary municipal election for the office of City Council to be held on September 1, 2015.

items.title: Infrastructure and Safety Resolves
items.summary: Referred requests for Winthrop Circle paving inspections, rotary signage, and crosswalk repainting to the DPW and Traffic Commission.

items.title: Environmental and Utility Project Resolutions
items.summary: Referred concerns regarding uncovered soil at Wellington Fellsway Plaza to the Board of Health and scheduled a public hearing for October 6 regarding an Eversource underground utility project.

items.title: Medford Square Pedestrian Path and Parking Office Hours
items.summary: Referred requests to investigate Saturday hours for the parking office and a potential pedestrian path linking the Campbell Peace Garden to Riverbend Park to the administration.
